messages:
lara: Saw a p95 spike on /v1/generate after the 21:45 canary to v2.4.7 (canary=10%). Start ~21:48 UTC.
ben: dev console shows retry storms and more kv_cache_miss logs. deploybot posted rollout completion at 21:46.
deploybot: rollout to v2.4.7 complete; canary=10% region=usw2. auto-signal: latency drift p95 > threshold for 3m. Autorevert=warn-only for this window.
matt: given dedicated customers on this route, prefer manual soft unwind to preserve traces. Suggest 10%->0% over 3m for dedicated only and pin v2.4.6 after verification.
sylvia: agree. Who can run the shift?
ops-rosa: I can. Command: `rictl traffic shift --service generator --from v2.4.7 --to v2.4.6 --percent 10 --scope dedicated --duration 180s`
lara: run it and capture kernel flags and allocstats before full revert.
ops-rosa: running -> response: ok shifting 10->0 over 180s (dedicated).
deploybot: update: canary now at 7% per rollout plan.
(2m)
ben: p95 improving as canary drops; CPU on dedicated nodes normalizing. Still collecting logs.
sylvia: start pin once at 0%: `rictl pin version --service generator --version v2.4.6 --scope dedicated --note "soft unwind 21:51 UTC"`
ops-rosa: pinned -> ok.
matt: opening rollback PR to revert infra canary manifests (WIP). Link: https://git.internal/infra/pulls/5010
sylvia: customer comms: short blurb ready for any affected tenants; will send after 20m verification.
lara: monitoring for 20m. If errors stay below 0.5% keep pin for 24h and run compatibility tests. If not, escalate to hard revert and open oncall bridge.
(20m later)
ben: traces show kernel fallback path on long sequences causing additional KV churn. Draft RCA in postmortems.
matt: merged rollback PR; manifests restored to v2.4.6 for canary.
sylvia: sent customer note at 22:15 UTC.
lara: decision: manual soft unwind executed, dedicated pinned v2.4.6 for 24h pending RCA and patch. Owners: ben=RCA, matt=PR+infra, sylvia=comms, ops-rosa=monitor. Closing immediate thread.
